text:
ben_support: hey team — multiple customers reporting intermittent 502/504s from the hosted API (us-west-2) starting ~08:12 UTC. mostly on /v1/generate and /v1/embeddings. error spikes correlate with a large burst of small, chatty requests. sample curl returns below.

ben_support: ```bash
$ curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACT" -d '{"input":"test"}'
HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
content-type: application/json
{"error":"Upstream reset before headers"}
```

emma_edge: saw this in Envoy too — spikes in upstream resets and 5xxs. cluster_health shows upstream_cx_destroy and upstream_rq_5xx climbing at the same time as the burst. digging into stats now. Datadog dashboard: https://app.datadog.example/dashboard/frontdoor-5xx :eyes:

emma_edge: snapshot of envoy cluster stats (trimmed):
```
cluster.frontdoor_upstreams.upstream_cx_active: 118
cluster.frontdoor_upstreams.upstream_cx_total: 4820
cluster.frontdoor_upstreams.upstream_cx_destroy: 534
cluster.frontdoor_upstreams.upstream_rq_pending_overflow: 27
cluster.frontdoor_upstreams.upstream_rq_5xx: 1287
cluster.frontdoor_upstreams.upstream_cx_connect_fail: 89
```

dan_oncall: timeline? any deploy or config change before 08:12?

ben_support: we rolled a change to connection reuse/keepalive tuning at 07:55 — enabled more aggressive HTTP/1.1 connection reuse on the front-door pool (to reduce CPU). rollout PR: https://git.internal/repo/changes/438

lina_sre: that change might have increased connection pipelining pressure on backend inference pods. are backends hitting fd/socket limits or epoll churn? any OOMs?

emma_edge: backend nodes show large numbers of CLOSE_WAIT and some `accept` errors on the inference service. looks like downstream (frontdoor) is reusing TCP connections but upstreams are closing aggressively which causes resets on new requests. also seeing `upstream request queued` / pending overflow in Envoy.

ben_support: customers seeing variable latency then 502s. SLA alerts triggered. I've messaged top affected accounts (enterprise) and created support tickets.

infra-bot: autoscaler: increased frontdoor-replica count from 12 -> 14 at 08:18 UTC due to CPU pressure.

emma_edge: autoscaler helped CPU but not the connection-flakiness. hypothesis: keepalive reuse + backend connection churn -> Envoy reports upstream reset before headers. quick mitigation options: 1) revert keepalive change (rollback PR), 2) temporarily set `Connection: close` for problematic routes via route config, 3) increase Envoy cluster `max_requests_per_connection` or disable connection pool reuse for these backends, 4) add a fallback route to a more stable pool (dedicated small-req pool).

dan_oncall: can we flip a config quickly? rollback would be fastest if it's the change. what does deploy-bot say about rollback impact?

deploy-bot: can rollback PR 438 to all frontdoor nodes in ~5m with a canary. ETA 8:40 UTC for canary, full at ~8:50 if healthy. Include `--no-scale` to avoid autoscaler churn.

lina_sre: also want to check fd limits on inference pods: `ss -s`, `cat /proc/sys/fs/file-max`, and container ulimits. if many CLOSE_WAITs, kernel backlog may be full.

emma_edge: reproduction steps I used (dev cluster): 1) spawn 200 parallel short POSTs with keepalive across a small pool, 2) observe upstream_cx_destroy / resets, 3) replicate by toggling `envoy.http1.max_requests_per_connection` lower and higher. repro script:```bash
for i in {1..200}; do curl -s -o /dev/null -H 'Connection: keep-alive' -X POST https://staging.api/v1/generate -d '{"input":"x"}' & done; wait
```

ben_support: customers need ETA. recommend rollback if deploy-bot can run canary quickly. otherwise we can route traffic to the dedicated fallback pool until fix.

dan_oncall: starting rollback canary now (emma / deploy-bot coordinate). will monitor envoy stats and 5xx rate. lina, can you snapshot backend socket state pre/post?

lina_sre: on it — running `ss -tanp` and dumping into k8s logs, will attach shortly. also increasing ulimit for inference pods by +10k as a flame test for fd exhaustion.

emma_edge: note — if we rollback, we should also consider adding a short `idle_timeout` on the frontdoor listener and increasing `envoy.cluster.conn_pool_size` to reduce queuing. follow-up config proposals in PR 439.

deploy-bot: rollback canary started at 08:28 UTC on 2/14 nodes.

infra-bot: monitoring alert: 5xx rate decreased from 12% -> 3% in canary region at 08:33 UTC.

ben_support: customer-facing update: "we're rolling a rollback for a recent connection-reuse optimization; we expect error rates to drop in ~15m. will update once stable." :white_check_mark:

emma_edge: after canary looks good, rolling global rollback. watch for side effects (CPU bump).

lina_sre: backend fd stats pre-rollback: `FD TOTAL: 65000 used: 62940`, many sockets in CLOSE_WAIT. post-rollback: CLOSE_WAIT count dropped ~85% after 3m.

dan_oncall: last_message: global rollback completed at 08:50 UTC. 5xxs ~0.5% now, latencies back to baseline. opening a postmortem ticket and assigning owners: emma_edge (lead), lina_sre (root cause infra), ben_support (customer comms).

ben_support: thanks all — I'll follow up with affected customers and include timeline + mitigation steps.

emma_edge: will draft postmortem and config suggestions (PR 439) for safer connection-reuse tuning and stronger canary gating.

lina_sre: follow-up checklist: increase pod ulimits, add socket usage dashboard, add alert for CLOSE_WAIT ratio, and test keepalive scenarios in perf lab.

dan_oncall: closing thread but keep it pinned to incidents until postmortem posted. :rotating_light:
